toegepas.voor: Daar loop die Limpopo-rivier en dit vorm
toegepas.na: Daar loop die Limpopo-rivier, en dit vorm
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Daar loop die Limpopo-rivier' / 'dit vorm').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two full clauses joined by 'en' take the AWS 2017 comma; nothing else changes.

toegepas.blok: Al hoe meer mense in die vallei
toegepas.voor: Die getal mense in die vallei het dus groter geword
toegepas.na: Die getal mense in die vallei het dus toegeneem
toegepas.rede_vinder: A number 'neem toe'; 'groter geword' is wooden for a count.
toegepas.fout: 'Die getal ... het groter geword' is wooden for a count.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A number 'neem toe' in natural Afrikaans, and the claim (more people) is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Party het graan gekweek en ander
toegepas.na: Party het graan verbou, en ander
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'; also 'graan verbou' is the idiomatic verb for crops.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en', and 'graan gekweek' is a weaker collocation than 'graan verbou'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required and 'graan verbou' is the idiomatic verb for crops, with the same people doing the same thing.

toegepas.voor: Party het potte van klei gemaak en ander het yster in gereedskap verwerk
toegepas.na: Party het potte van klei gemaak, en ander het yster tot gereedskap verwerk
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en', and the preposition with 'verwerk' is 'tot', not 'in'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses, and 'in gereedskap verwerk' copies English 'process into'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Afrikaans says 'iets tot iets verwerk', and the comma is required; the claim is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: En 'n paar mense het die nedersetting gelei.
toegepas.na: 'n Paar mense het die nedersetting gelei.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Opening a sentence with 'En' reads as spoken style in a study text and adds nothing.
toegepas.fout: Opening a sentence with 'En' is a spoken habit in a study text.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Dropping 'En' loses no information and the sentence still reads as the last item after 'party ... ander'.

toegepas.voor: die nat soom van die groot vleiland
toegepas.na: die nat rand van die groot vleiland
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'soom' for the edge of a wetland is literary and unfamiliar at Grade 6; 'rand' says the same plainly.
toegepas.fout: 'soom' for the edge of a wetland is a literary word a Grade 6 reader may not know.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'rand' means the same edge in plain words, and the claim about which land was worked is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The idiom collocates with 'noukeurig'; 'presies boek hou' is a calque.
toegepas.fout: 'presies boek hou' is a calque of 'keep precise records'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The fixed Afrikaans collocation is 'noukeurig boek hou', and it still says the archaeologists record exactly what lies where.

laat_vaar.voor: Mense het hier gewoon lank voordat Mapungubwe 'n koninkryk geword het.
laat_vaar.na: Lank voordat Mapungubwe 'n koninkryk geword het, het mense al hier gewoon.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The adverbial 'lank voordat...' trailing after the verb is loose spoken word order; fronting it reads as natural written Afrikaans, and 'koninkryk' is kept.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original word order reads naturally, and the proposal is a reordering that also adds 'al', which is a lateral move with an added word.

laat_vaar.blok: Al hoe meer mense in die vallei
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A year is written without a thousands space.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: '1 300 nC' is the curriculum's own printed form and must stay as it is.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The compound is the natural form and avoids the double 'van' with 'onder meer van diere en mense'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'baie beeldjies van klei' is fact wording still waiting for its check, it is correct Afrikaans as it stands, and the compound is only a lateral rewording.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The time phrase needs a preposition in written Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Omtrent dieselfde tyd' is correct Afrikaans without a preposition, and 'omtrent in dieselfde tyd' reads worse.
'baie krale van glas' is fact wording still waiting for its check and reads correctly, so the compound is only a lateral change.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: One 'skryf iets neer' on paper; 'op papier geskryf' is slightly unidiomatic.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'op papier geskryf' is natural Afrikaans, and 'neergeskryf' only reads differently.

laat_vaar.voor: Daar is deur al hierdie jare in die vallei
laat_vaar.na: Regdeur hierdie jare is daar in die vallei
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'deur al hierdie jare' calques 'through all these years'; 'regdeur hierdie jare' is the Afrikaans form.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'deur al hierdie jare' is good Afrikaans for 'throughout these years', so the reordering to 'regdeur' is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.voor: dat dinge gereël is en in 'n orde staan
na_skrywer.na: dat dinge goed gereël en georden is
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'in 'n orde staan' is not idiomatic Afrikaans; 'georden is' says the same.
na_skrywer.fout: 'in 'n orde staan' is not idiomatic Afrikaans in the glossary definition of 'georganiseerd'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition and adds 'goed', so the writer should fix the unidiomatic phrase in the definition.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: Block heading: 'kom onder' calques English 'come under'; the body says 'onder 'n middelpunt ... begin val', so 'val onder' would match. Not proposed because a heading change may not be applicable.

vlae.teks: Dié wat nie weggetrek het nie, het mettertyd deel van een ander groep geword.
vlae.rede: 'een ander groep' is wooden and does not say which group (the newcomers of K2?). It cannot be fixed without guessing the intended content.

vlae.teks: So het die manier waarop die grond bewerk is, meer kompleks geword.
vlae.rede: 'ingewikkelder' would be plainer at Grade 6, but 'kompleks' may be a CAPS term for this topic, so not proposed; the reviewer can decide.

vlae.teks: Daar loop die Limpopo-rivier en dit vorm ons land se grens.
vlae.rede: Reads as if the river is the whole national border; it is only part of the northern border. Wording a fix would add content, so it is flagged, not changed.

vlae.teks: Al die mense wat saam leef en met mekaar te doen het.
vlae.rede: This glossary term does not appear anywhere in the lesson text. The entry is also a fragment, where the other entries are full sentences.
